# Solomon Builds the Temple Story Path

**Lesson:** K4-L08 - Solomon Builds the Temple

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for Solomon Builds the Temple.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

1 Kings 8:22-30, 54-61

## Big idea

Solomon recognised that even the temple could not contain the sovereign God.

## Guardrails

Do not describe the temple as a container that confined God; Solomon explicitly rejects that idea. | Avoid turning temple imagery into a claim that church buildings are uniquely sacred spaces.
